description: Customize this file to add/remove packages to check and update. Rename to 'frup_config.json' to use.

packages.name: sideband
packages.comment: LXMF client for Android/Linux/macOS - PyPI name is 'sbapp'

packages.name: meshchat
packages.comment: Web-based mesh chat - GitHub only, manual installation required

packages.name: columba
packages.comment: Terminal-based LXMF client - GitHub only, manual installation required

packages.name: rnode
packages.comment: Official RNode firmware - Flash to hardware, not pip installable

packages.name: rnode_ce
packages.comment: RNode Community Edition firmware - Flash to hardware

field_descriptions.name: Internal identifier (lowercase, no spaces, used as key)
field_descriptions.display_name: Human-readable name shown to user in output
field_descriptions.pypi_name: Package name on PyPI for 'pip install'. Set to null for GitHub-only packages
field_descriptions.url: GitHub repository URL for reference and fallback checking
field_descriptions.manual_install: true = Cannot be installed via pip, only manual installation
field_descriptions.skip_local_check: true = Don't check if installed locally
field_descriptions.skip_version_comparison: true = Don't compare versions or offer updates
field_descriptions.online_only: true = Only fetch online version, don't show in comparison section
field_descriptions.comment: Optional field for your notes (ignored by FRUP)

add_installable_package_different_pypi_n.name: myapp
add_installable_package_different_pypi_n.comment: PyPI name differs from display name

usage_tips: Set pypi_name to null for packages only available on GitHub
Use manual_install: true for firmware or non-Python packages
online_only: true shows version but doesn't offer installation
Remove packages you don't want to track
Add your own custom packages to the 'packages' array
The 'name' field must be unique across all packages
notes: FRUP checks PyPI first (faster), then falls back to GitHub if pypi_name is null
GitHub-only packages are fetched from releases/latest endpoint
Version comparison ignores 'v' or 'V' prefixes automatically
Packages marked manual_install will only show update notifications
Use --save-config to regenerate this example anytime
